Definition: from G2279; to make a loud noise, i.e. reverberate:--roar, sound.
BiblicalUsage: Paul uses this word once, for a sounding brass or a tinkling cymbal, the loud empty noise of a gong. Without love, he says, even the most gifted speech is only that, a noise that rings and means nothing.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe love is what turns noise into something real, and without it my words are only a clanging sound.
